title: Input range for PNG block CRC
summary: PNG's block CRC covers the four-byte type and data, including the type even if the data is empty.
detail: When calculating the CRC of a block, starting from the type field, four type bytes are taken followed by all the data. The stored CRC is read in big-endian order.
boundary: Neither the length field nor the stored CRC participate in the calculation. Although the data of IEND is empty, the CRC input is still four type bytes IEND.
relevance: When checking whether an image is corrupted, taking the wrong CRC input range can misjudge valid blocks as corrupted.
